attchmntText: Semac Construction Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of financial result for the Quarter ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Semac Construction Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of its Unaudited Financial Statements for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The statements were published on 14th November 2026 in Malai Murasu and Business Standard. The filing complies with Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The document also contains unrelated news clippings from Precot Limited regarding the publication of its quarterly results on 13th November 2026. Additional text includes local news reports from Coimbatore dated 14th November 2026 covering water supply issues, a lost document declaration, health awareness campaigns, agricultural loan schemes, temple renovations, and crime reports.

attchmntText: Semac Construction Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Semac Construction Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and period ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 13th November 2026. Statutory auditors Suresh Surana & Associates LLP issued an unmodified opinion on the results. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 7058.05 lakh rupees. Profit before tax was 33.29 lakh rupees. Profit after tax was 7.35 lakh rupees. Basic earnings per share was 0.23 rupees. Total assets stood at 17591.30 lakh rupees as of 30th September 2026. Cash and cash equivalents were 85.29 lakh rupees. The company operates in the Engineering, Procurement and Construction Services segment.
